title: tecoma hirsuta
intro: Tecoma hirsuta, commonly known as Yellow Trumpetbush or Yellow Elder, is a plant species in the family Bignoniaceae, native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties. Tecoma hirsuta contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. The health benefits of the plant include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory health, and exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial properties.
